messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty — service="inference-gateway" alert="error_rate_percent" threshold=10% window=5m. Current: 14.2% 5xx across prod-usw2. Link: https://pd/redwood/incidents/INC-1745551230
jamie (oncall): Acked. Investigating. Any visible deploys? :mag:
pagerbot: Auto-suppression not active. No recent deploys in the last 30m. Top-affected route: /v1/generate (latency normal, errors spike).
deepa: seeing increased 502s from edge -> origin proxy; tails show upstream timeouts in logs. Sample curl to health: ```curl -i https://gateway-usw2.internal/health | head```
marco: can we scale the inference pool for dedicated customers and shift traffic off canaries? Suggest temporarily enable route-level failover to model-variant-b for non-enterprise customers.
jamie (oncall): Good plan. I'll open a routing override and scale pool x2. Running scale now: ```rctl scale pool inference-pool-prod-usw2 --replicas 24```
sre-rotation: Adding a KV cache warmup step — spikes could be from cache churn after recent config change. Triggering warmup job: ```jobs start kvcache-warmup --region usw2 --buckets 8```
jamie (oncall): Done scale + warmup started. Observability note: error rate dropping from 14.2% -> 9.6% in last 60s. Customer impact: a handful of non-critical PLG customers saw degraded responses; no enterprise SLA breaches yet.
deepa: Confirming logs show fewer upstream 504s after pool scale. Rolling back any recent proxy tweak? I see a config set change 18m ago on auth-proxy, not sure related.
marco: If it dips below threshold, hold for 10m then remove routing override. Also recommend adjusting PD alert debounce to 3m to avoid flapping.
jamie (oncall): Agreed. Holding for stabilization. Updating incident doc: https://confluence/redwood/incidents/1745551230-postmortem. Will handoff to day oncall in 20m unless it resurfaces. :white_check_mark:
incidentbot: Note: PagerDuty escalation chain resumed if error_rate_percent > 10% for 3 consecutive 1m windows.
sre-rotation: Adding a brief runbook note — if kvcache eviction rate > 100/s, run evict diagnostics and consider increasing cache size. Command: ```promql: rate(kvcache_evicts_total[1m]) > 100```
jamie (oncall): Last update before handoff: error rate stable at 4.1% (5m). Leaving routing override in place until 10:20 UTC, then rollback if stable. Handoff to @marco in 20m. :handshake:
marco: Taking over watch. Leave a note in the doc if anything changes. :thumbsup:
